euFramework.title: Full EU-Compliant Framework
euFramework.body: Supports EN 15804+A2, EN 15978, EU Taxonomy and Level(s) so your Whole-Life Carbon results are consistent, auditable and regulator-ready.

aggregation.title: High-Accuracy Aggregation
aggregation.body: Combines embodied, operational and end-of-life impacts across all materials and energy sources in one structured workflow.

reporting.title: Professional Reporting Engine
reporting.body: Produces clean, regulator-ready reports and advanced analytics layouts aligned with European engineering expectations.

materialsHub.title: Materials Intelligence Hub
materialsHub.body: Manage materials, EPDs and stage-based profiles in a single structured interface designed for Whole-Life Carbon workflows.

projectWlc.title: Project-level WLC Analysis
projectWlc.body: Calculate A1–A3, A–D and B6 energy impacts with clear separation of embodied, operational and end-of-life stages.

climateBenchmarking.title: Climate-zone Benchmarking
climateBenchmarking.body: Compare projects against Nordic, Central European and Mediterranean benchmarks for realistic performance insights.

stageAdjusted.title: Stage-adjusted Accuracy Model
stageAdjusted.body: Adjust benchmarks for Concept, Design, Tender and As-built stages to reflect real project maturity.

indicatorSet.title: Full EN 15804+A2 Indicator Set
indicatorSet.body: Includes GWP, AP, EP-F/M/T, ODP, POCP, ADP-F/M, WDP, HWD, NHWD, RWD and more — no shortcuts.

outputs.title: Regulatory & Advanced Outputs
outputs.body: Switch between compact regulatory reports and advanced analytics views depending on audience and use case.
